An object of mass 1.2kg is moving with a velocity of 2.0m/s when it is acted on by a force of
4.0N. The velocity of the object increases to 5.0m/s in the same direction.
For which period of time does the force act on the object?
A
0.90s
B
1.1s
C
1.5s
D
3.6s
subject: Physics
